scope: Imported Project software evidence and existing results_bit-width hardware reports; no simulation or Vivado execution implied by import.
path_normalization: Host replaced by REDACTED; Windows/macOS user-home prefixes by <USER_HOME>; macOS temporary prefixes by <TMPDIR>. Numeric results are unchanged. Curated Vivado reports also remove trailing spaces/tabs; numeric content is unchanged. All packaged text files use LF line endings for Git checkout stability. Imported text logs also have trailing spaces/tabs removed. Preserved logs use .txt extension so generated *.log ignores remain applicable.
